sections.label: Book 24
sections.name: The victims of the Horse Sacrifice enumerated

verses.sa: अश्वस्तूपरो गोमृगस्ते प्राजापत्याः कृष्णग्रीव आग्नेयो रराटे पुरस्तात्सारस्वती मेष्यधस्ताद्धन्वोराश्विनावधोरामौ बाह्वोः सौमापौष्णः श्यामो नाभ्यां सौर्ययामौ श्वेतश्च कृष्णश्च पार्श्वयोस्त्वाष्ट्रौ लोमशसक्थौ सक्थ्योर्वायव्यः श्वेतः पुच्छ इन्द्राय स्वपस्याय वेहद्वैष्णवो वामनः॥
verses.tr: aśvastūparo gomṛgaste prājāpatyāḥ kṛṣṇagrīva āgneyo rarāṭe purastātsārasvatī meṣyadhastāddhanvorāśvināvadhorāmau bāhvoḥ saumāpauṣṇaḥ śyāmo nābhyāṃ sauryayāmau śvetaśca kṛṣṇaśca pārśvayostvāṣṭrau lomaśasakthau sakthyorvāyavyaḥ śvetaḥ puccha indrāya svapasyāya vehadvaiṣṇavo vāmanaḥ
verses.en: Horse, hornless goat, 'Gororiga,, these belong to Pimjapalii. A black-uecked goat, devoted to Agni,((is to 'be bound) in front to the forehead((of the horse), arasvati's ewe below his jaws; two goats belonging to the Asvins, with marks on the lower parts of the body, to his fore-legs; a dark-coloured goat, Soma's and Ptishhan's, to his navel; a white and a black, sacred to Soma and Yama, to his sides; Tvashtar's two, with bushy tails, to his hind feet; V Vayu's white goat to his tail; for Indra the Good Worker a cow who slips her calf; a dwarf belonging to Vishnu.

verses.sa: रोहितो धूम्ररोहितः कर्कन्धुरोहितस्ते सौम्या बभ्रुररुणबभ्रुः शुकबभ्रुस्ते वारुणाः शितिरन्ध्रोऽन्यतः शितिरन्ध्रः समन्तशितिरन्ध्रस्ते सावित्राः शितिबाहुरन्यतः शितिबाहु समन्तशितिबाहुस्ते बार्हस्पत्याः पृषती क्षुद्रपृषती स्थूलपृषती ता मैत्रावरुण्यः॥
verses.tr: rohito dhūmrarohitaḥ karkandhurohitaste saumyā babhruraruṇababhruḥ śukababhruste vāruṇāḥ śitirandhro'nyataḥ śitirandhraḥ samantaśitirandhraste sāvitrāḥ śitibāhuranyataḥ śitibāhu samantaśitibāhuste bārhaspatyāḥ pṛṣatī kṣudrapṛṣatī sthūlapṛṣatī tā maitrāvaruṇyaḥ
verses.en: The red goat, the smoky-red, the jujube-red, these belong to Soma. The brown, the ruddy-brown, the parrot-brown, these are Varuna's. One with white ear holes, one with partly white, one with wholly white, belong to Savitar. One with fore feet white, partly white, wholly white, belongs to Bi Brihaspati. -She-goats speckled, with small spots, with big spots, these belong to Mitra-Yaruna.

verses.sa: शुद्धवालः सर्वशुद्धवालो मणिवालस्त आश्विनाः श्येतः श्येताक्षोऽरुणस्ते रुद्राय पशुपतये कर्णा यामा अवलिप्ता रौद्रा नभोरूपाः पार्जन्याः॥
verses.tr: śuddhavālaḥ sarvaśuddhavālo maṇivālasta āśvināḥ śyetaḥ śyetākṣo'ruṇaste rudrāya paśupataye karṇā yāmā avaliptā raudrā nabhorūpāḥ pārjanyāḥ
verses.en: The bright-tailed, the wholly bright-tailed, the jewel-tailed, these belong to the Asvins. The white, the white-eyed, the reddish, these are for Rudra Lord of Beasts. Long-eared goats are for Yama; proud -ones for Rudra; cloud-coloured ones for Parjanya.

verses.sa: पृश्निस्तिरश्चीनपृश्निरूर्ध्वपृश्निस्ते मारुताः फल्गूर्लोहितोर्णी पलक्षी ताः सारस्वत्यः प्लीहाकर्णः शुण्ठाकर्णोऽध्यालोहकर्णस्ते त्वाष्ट्राः कृष्णग्रीवः शितिकक्षोऽञ्जिसक्थस्त ऐन्द्राग्नाः कृष्णाञ्जिरल्पाञ्जिर्महाञ्जिस्त उषस्याः॥
verses.tr: pṛśnistiraścīnapṛśnirūrdhvapṛśniste mārutāḥ phalgūrlohitorṇī palakṣī tāḥ sārasvatyaḥ plīhākarṇaḥ śuṇṭhākarṇo'dhyālohakarṇaste tvāṣṭrāḥ kṛṣṇagrīvaḥ śitikakṣo'ñjisakthasta aindrāgnāḥ kṛṣṇāñjiralpāñjirmahāñjista uṣasyāḥ
verses.en: Goats speckled, transversely speckled, upward speckled are for the Maruts. The reddish she-goat, the red-haired, the white, these belong to Sarasvati. The goat with diseased ears, the short-eared, the red eared are Tvashtar's. The black-necked, the white-flanked, one with bright-coloured thighs belong to Indra and Agni. Those with black marks, small marks, large marks belong to Dawn.

verses.sa: शिल्पा वैश्वदेव्यो रोहिण्यस्त्र्यवयो वाचेऽविज्ञाता अदित्यै सरूपा धात्रे वत्सतर्यो देवानां पत्नीभ्यः॥
verses.tr: śilpā vaiśvadevyo rohiṇyastryavayo vāce'vijñātā adityai sarūpā dhātre vatsataryo devānāṃ patnībhyaḥ
verses.en: -Parti-coloured female victims belong to the All-Gods; r^dcolonred, eighteen months old to Vak; victims without distinguishing marks to Aditi; those.of one same colour to Dhatar; weaned kids sacred to the Consorts of the Gods.

verses.sa: कृष्णग्रीवा आग्नेयाः शितिभ्रवो वसूनां रोहिता रुद्राणां श्वेता अवरोकिण आदित्यानां नभोरूपाः पार्जन्याः॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyāḥ śitibhravo vasūnāṃ rohitā rudrāṇāṃ śvetā avarokiṇa ādityānāṃ nabhorūpāḥ pārjanyāḥ
verses.en: Black-necked victims for Agni; white browed for the Vasus; red for Rudra; bright ones for the Adityas; cloud-coloured for Parjanya.

verses.sa: उन्नत ऋषभो वामनस्त ऐन्द्रवैष्णवा उन्नतः शितिबाहुः शितिपृष्ठस्त ऐन्द्राबार्हस्पत्याः शुकरूपा वाजिनाः कल्माषा आग्निमारुताः श्यामाः पौष्णाः॥
verses.tr: unnata ṛṣabho vāmanasta aindravaiṣṇavā unnataḥ śitibāhuḥ śitipṛṣṭhasta aindrābārhaspatyāḥ śukarūpā vājināḥ kalmāṣā āgnimārutāḥ śyāmāḥ pauṣṇāḥ
verses.en: The tall goa)t, the sturdy, the dwarf, these are Indra- Vishnu's; the tall, the white fore-footed, the black-backed, Indra-Brihaspati's; parrot-coloured the VAjins; speckled Agni- Maruts'; dark 'coloured Pushaa's.

verses.sa: एता ऐन्द्राग्ना द्विरूपा अग्नीषोमीया वामना अनड्वाह आग्नावैष्णवा वशा मैत्रावरुण्योऽन्यतएन्यो मैत्र्यः॥
verses.tr: etā aindrāgnā dvirūpā agnīṣomīyā vāmanā anaḍvāha āgnāvaiṣṇavā vaśā maitrāvaruṇyo'nyataenyo maitryaḥ
verses.en: Variegated, Indra; Agni's; two-coloured, Agni-Soma's; dwarf oxen, Agni- Vishnu's; barren, cows, Mitra-Varuna's; partly variegated, Mitra's.,

verses.sa: कृष्णग्रीवा आग्नेया बभ्रवः सौम्याः श्वेता वायव्या अविज्ञाता अदित्यै सरूपा धात्रे वत्सतर्यो देवानां पत्नीभ्यः॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyā babhravaḥ saumyāḥ śvetā vāyavyā avijñātā adityai sarūpā dhātre vatsataryo devānāṃ patnībhyaḥ
verses.en: Black -necked ones, Agni's; brown. Soma's; white, Vayu's; undistinguished, Aditi's; self-coloured, Dhatar's; weanlings, the Gods' Consorts'.

verses.sa: कृष्णा भौमा धूम्रा आन्तरिक्षा बृहन्तो दिव्याः शबला वैद्युताः सिध्मास्तारकाः॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇā bhaumā dhūmrā āntarikṣā bṛhanto divyāḥ śabalā vaidyutāḥ sidhmāstārakāḥ
verses.en: Elack ones for Earth; smoke-coloured for Firmament; tall ones for Sky; brindled ones for Lightning; blotched ones for Stars.

verses.sa: धूम्रान्वसन्तायालभते श्वेतान्ग्रीष्माय कृष्णान्वर्षाभ्योऽरुणाञ्छरदे पृषतो हेमन्ताय पिशङ्गाञ्छिशिराय॥
verses.tr: dhūmrānvasantāyālabhate śvetāngrīṣmāya kṛṣṇānvarṣābhyo'ruṇāñcharade pṛṣato hemantāya piśaṅgāñchiśirāya
verses.en: ; Smoke-colo-A'ed ones be sacrifices to Spring; white to Summer; black to the Rains; red ones to Autumn; speckled to Winter; reddish-yellow to the Dewy Season.

verses.sa: त्र्यवयो गायत्र्यै पञ्चावयस्त्रिष्टुभे दित्यवाहो जगत्यै त्रिवत्सा अनुष्टुभे तुर्यवाह उष्णिहे॥
verses.tr: tryavayo gāyatryai pañcāvayastriṣṭubhe dityavāho jagatyai trivatsā anuṣṭubhe turyavāha uṣṇihe
verses.en: <!! Calves eighteen months old to GAyatri; steers of two And a half years to Trishtup; two year old steers to Jagat; three year olds to Anushtup; four year olds to Ushnih.

verses.sa: पष्ठवाहो विराज उक्षाणो बृहत्या ऋषभाः ककुभेऽनड्वाहः पङ्क्त्यै धेनवोऽतिच्छन्दसे॥
verses.tr: paṣṭhavāho virāja ukṣāṇo bṛhatyā ṛṣabhāḥ kakubhe'naḍvāhaḥ paṅktyai dhenavo'ticchandase
verses.en: Four year old steers to Viraj; full grown bulls to Brihatt; strong bulls to Kakup; draught oxen to Pankti; xoilchcuws to Atichhandas.

verses.sa: कृष्णग्रीवा आग्नेया बभ्रवः सौम्या उपध्वस्ताः सावित्रा वत्सतर्यः सारस्वत्यः श्यामाः पौष्णाः पृश्नयो मारुता बहुरूपा वैश्वदेवा वशा द्यावापृथिवीयाः॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyā babhravaḥ saumyā upadhvastāḥ sāvitrā vatsataryaḥ sārasvatyaḥ śyāmāḥ pauṣṇāḥ pṛśnayo mārutā bahurūpā vaiśvadevā vaśā dyāvāpṛthivīyāḥ
verses.en: Black -necked victims sacred to Agni; brown to Soma; spotted to Savitar; weaned she-kids to Sarasvat; dark-coloured goats to PAshan; speckled victims to the If Maruts; many-coloured to the All-Gods; barren cows to Heaven and Earth.

verses.sa: उक्ताः सञ्चरा एता ऐन्द्राग्नाः कृष्णाः वारुणाः पृश्नयो मारुताः कायास्तूपराः॥
verses.tr: uktāḥ sañcarā etā aindrāgnāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ vāruṇāḥ pṛśnayo mārutāḥ kāyāstūparāḥ
verses.en: Called contemporary, the dappled belong to Indra-Agni; black ones to Varuna; speckled to the MarUts; hornless he-goats to Ka.

verses.sa: अग्नयेऽनीकवते प्रथमजानालभते मरुद्भ्यः सान्तपनेभ्यः सवात्यान्मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधिभ्यो बष्किहान्मरुद्भ्यः क्रीडिभ्यः संसृष्टान्मरुद्भ्यः स्वतवद्भ्योऽनुसृष्टान्॥
verses.tr: agnaye'nīkavate prathamajānālabhate marudbhyaḥ sāntapanebhyaḥ savātyānmarudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyo baṣkihānmarudbhyaḥ krīḍibhyaḥ saṃsṛṣṭānmarudbhyaḥ svatavadbhyo'nusṛṣṭān
verses.en: To Agni foremost in place he sacrtHces firstling goats; to the consuming Maruts those born of one mother; to the Maruts who perform domestic rites those born after a long time; to the sportive Maruts those born together; to the self strong Maruts those born in succession.

verses.sa: उक्ताः सञ्चरा एता ऐन्द्राग्नाः प्राशृङ्गा माहेन्द्रा बहुरूपा वैश्वकर्मणाः॥
verses.tr: uktāḥ sañcarā etā aindrāgnāḥ prāśṛṅgā māhendrā bahurūpā vaiśvakarmaṇāḥ
verses.en: Called contemporaneous, the dappled belonging to Indra-Agni; those with projecting horns to Mahendra; the many-coloured to Visvakarman.

verses.sa: धूम्रा बभ्रुनीकाशाः पितॄणां सोमवतां बभ्रवो धूम्रनीकाशाः पितॄणां बर्हिषदां कृष्णा बभ्रुनीकाशाः पितॄणामग्निष्वात्तानां कृष्णाः पृषन्तस्त्रैयम्बकाः॥
verses.tr: dhūmrā babhrunīkāśāḥ pitṝṇāṃ somavatāṃ babhravo dhūmranīkāśāḥ pitṝṇāṃ barhiṣadāṃ kṛṣṇā babhrunīkāśāḥ pitṝṇāmagniṣvāttānāṃ kṛṣṇāḥ pṛṣantastraiyambakāḥ
verses.en: Smoke-coloured, those of brownish hue, to be offered to the Soma-possessing Fathers; the brown and the smoky-looking to the Fathers who sit on sacred grass; the black and the brownish-looking to the Fathers who have been 'tasted by Agni; the black and the spotted belong to Tryambaka.

verses.sa: उक्ताः सञ्चरा एताः शुनासीरीयाः श्वेता वायव्याः श्वेताः सौर्याः॥
verses.tr: uktāḥ sañcarā etāḥ śunāsīrīyāḥ śvetā vāyavyāḥ śvetāḥ sauryāḥ
verses.en: Called contemporaneous, the dappled belong to §Suna and Sira; white ones to V^yu; white ones to Surya.

verses.sa: वसन्ताय कपिञ्जलानालभते ग्रीष्माय कलविङ्कान्वर्षाभ्यस्तित्तिरीञ्छरदे वर्तिका हेमन्ताय ककराञ्छिशिराय विककरान्॥
verses.tr: vasantāya kapiñjalānālabhate grīṣmāya kalaviṅkānvarṣābhyastittirīñcharade vartikā hemantāya kakarāñchiśirāya vikakarān
verses.en: To Spring he offt-rs Kapinjalas; to Summer sparrows; to the Rains partridges; to Autumn quail: to Winter Makaras; to the Dewy Season Vikakaras.

verses.sa: समुद्राय शिशुमारानालभते पर्जन्याय मण्डूकानद्भ्यो मत्स्यान्मित्राय कुलीपयान्वरुणाय नाक्रान्॥
verses.tr: samudrāya śiśumārānālabhate parjanyāya maṇḍūkānadbhyo matsyānmitrāya kulīpayānvaruṇāya nākrān
verses.en: To the Sea he sacrifices porpoises; to Parjanya frogs; to the Waters fishes; to Mitra Kulipaya; to Varuo crocodiles.

verses.sa: सोमाय हंसानालभते वायवे बलाका इन्द्राग्निभ्यां क्रुञ्चान्मित्राय मद्गून्वरुणाय चक्रवाकान्॥
verses.tr: somāya haṃsānālabhate vāyave balākā indrāgnibhyāṃ kruñcānmitrāya madgūnvaruṇāya cakravākān
verses.en: To Soma he lie sacrifices wild geese; to female cranes; to Indra Agni curlews; to Mitra divers; to Varuna €hakraylikH.

verses.sa: अग्नये कुटरूनालभते वनस्पतिभ्य उलूकानग्नीषोमाभ्यां चाषानश्विभ्यां मयूरान्मित्रावरुणाभ्यां कपोतान्॥
verses.tr: agnaye kuṭarūnālabhate vanaspatibhya ulūkānagnīṣomābhyāṃ cāṣānaśvibhyāṃ mayūrānmitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ kapotān
verses.en: To Agni h, e aerifioes cocks; to Vanaspatis owls; to Agni- blue jays; to the Asvins peacocks, to Mitra- Varuna pigeons.

verses.sa: सोमाय लबानालभते त्वष्ट्रे कौलीकान्गोषादीर्देवानां पत्नीभ्यः कुलीका देवजामिभ्योऽग्नये गृहपतये पारुष्णान्॥
verses.tr: somāya labānālabhate tvaṣṭre kaulīkāngoṣādīrdevānāṃ patnībhyaḥ kulīkā devajāmibhyo'gnaye gṛhapataye pāruṣṇān
verses.en: To Soma he sacrifices quails; to Tvashtar Kaultkas; Mai-nas to the Gods' Consorts; Kulikas to the Gods' Sisters; Parushijas to Agni Lord of the Homestead.

verses.sa: अह्ने पारावतानालभते रात्र्यै सीचापूरहोरात्रयोः सन्धिभ्यो जतूर्मासेभ्यो दात्यौहान्त्संवत्सराय महतः सुपर्णान्॥
verses.tr: ahne pārāvatānālabhate rātryai sīcāpūrahorātrayoḥ sandhibhyo jatūrmāsebhyo dātyauhāntsaṃvatsarāya mahataḥ suparṇān
verses.en: To Day he sacrifices doves; to Night Sichipus; to the Joints of Day and Night bits; to the Months gallinules; to the Year great eagles.

verses.sa: भूम्या आखूनालभतेऽन्तरिक्षाय पाङ्क्त्रान्दिवे कशान्दिग्भ्यो नकुलान्बभ्रुकानवान्तरदिशाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: bhūmyā ākhūnālabhate'ntarikṣāya pāṅktrāndive kaśāndigbhyo nakulānbabhrukānavāntaradiśābhyaḥ
verses.en: To Ground he sacrifices rats; to Firmament field-rats; to Day vol^s; to the Quarters mungooses; to the Intermediate Spaces brownish ichueumous.

verses.sa: वसुभ्य ऋश्यानालभते रुद्रेभ्यो रुरूनादित्येभ्यो न्यङ्कून्विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः पृषतान्त्साध्येभ्यः कुलुङ्गान्॥
verses.tr: vasubhya ṛśyānālabhate rudrebhyo rurūnādityebhyo nyaṅkūnviśvebhyo devebhyaḥ pṛṣatāntsādhyebhyaḥ kuluṅgān
verses.en: To the Vasus he sacrifices black-bucks; to the Rudras stags; to the Adityas yanku deer; to the All-Gods spotted deer; to the Sadhyas Kulinga antelopes, A

verses.sa: ईशानाय परस्वत आलभते मित्राय गौरान्वरुणाय महिषान्बृहस्पतये गवयाँस्त्वष्ट्र उष्ट्रान्॥
verses.tr: īśānāya parasvata ālabhate mitrāya gaurānvaruṇāya mahiṣānbṛhaspataye gavayāṃstvaṣṭra uṣṭrān
verses.en: To Is^ua he sacrifices wild asses; to Mitra Asuras; to Varuna buffaloes; to Brihaspati Gayals; to Tvashtar camels.

verses.sa: प्रजापतये पुरुषान्हस्तिन आलभते वाचे प्लुषीँश्चक्षुषे मशकाञ्छ्रोत्राय भृङ्गाः॥
verses.tr: prajāpataye puruṣānhastina ālabhate vāce pluṣīṃścakṣuṣe maśakāñchrotrāya bhṛṅgāḥ
verses.en: To Prajipati he sacrifices men elephants; fo to Y^k white ants; to Sight flies; to Hearing black: bees.

verses.sa: प्रजापतये च वायवे च गोमृगो वरुणायारण्यो मेषो यमाय कृष्णो मनुष्यराजाय मर्कटः शार्दूलाय रोहिदृषभाय गवयी क्षिप्रश्येनाय वर्तिका नीलङ्गोः कृमिः समुद्राय शिशुमारो हिमवते हस्ती॥
verses.tr: prajāpataye ca vāyave ca gomṛgo varuṇāyāraṇyo meṣo yamāya kṛṣṇo manuṣyarājāya markaṭaḥ śārdūlāya rohidṛṣabhāya gavayī kṣipraśyenāya vartikā nīlaṅgoḥ kṛmiḥ samudrāya śiśumāro himavate hastī
verses.en: '30 To Prajipati and to VAyu a Gayal is to be offered; to Varuna a wild ram; to Yama (a black ram; to a human king a monkey; to the Tiger a red doe; to the Bull a female Gayal, to the Kshiprai>yena a quail; to the Nllangu a worm; to the Sea a porpoise; to the Snowy Mountain an elephant.

verses.sa: मयुः प्राजापत्य उलो हलिक्ष्णो वृषदंशस्ते धात्रे दिशां कङ्को धुङ्क्षाग्नेयी कलविङ्को लोहिताहिः पुष्करसादस्ते त्वाष्ट्रा वाचे क्रुञ्चः॥
verses.tr: mayuḥ prājāpatya ulo halikṣṇo vṛṣadaṃśaste dhātre diśāṃ kaṅko dhuṅkṣāgneyī kalaviṅko lohitāhiḥ puṣkarasādaste tvāṣṭrā vāce kruñcaḥ
verses.en: The Kinnara belongs to Prajapati; the Ula, the Bhaikshya, the cat belong to Dliatar; the heron belongs to the Quarters; the Dbunksha to Agni; sparrow, red snake, Saras, these are Tvashtar's; the curlew belongs to VAk. V^k.

verses.sa: सोमाय कुलुङ्ग आरण्योऽजो नकुलः शका ते पौष्णाः क्रोष्टा मायोरिन्द्रस्य गौरमृगः पिद्वो न्यङ्कुः कक्कटस्तेऽनुमत्यै प्रतिश्रुत्कायै चक्रवाकः॥
verses.tr: somāya kuluṅga āraṇyo'jo nakulaḥ śakā te pauṣṇāḥ kroṣṭā māyorindrasya gauramṛgaḥ pidvo nyaṅkuḥ kakkaṭaste'numatyai pratiśrutkāyai cakravākaḥ
verses.en: To Soma an antelope is to be offered; wild goat, mun-goose, $Sak, these are PAshan's; the jackal is the Manyu's; the Gaura Indra's; Pinda, antelope, cock, these are Anumati's; the Chakravdka is for £Echo:

verses.sa: सौरी बलाका शार्गः सृजयः शयाण्डकस्ते मैत्राः सरस्वत्यै शारिः पुरुषवाक् श्वाविद्भौमी शार्दूलो वृकः पृदाकुस्ते मन्यवे सरस्वते शुकः पुरुषवाक्॥
verses.tr: saurī balākā śārgaḥ sṛjayaḥ śayāṇḍakaste maitrāḥ sarasvatyai śāriḥ puruṣavāk śvāvidbhaumī śārdūlo vṛkaḥ pṛdākuste manyave sarasvate śukaḥ puruṣavāk
verses.en: The female crane is SArya's; §S&rga, Srijay, $ayan<jlaka, these are Mitra's; to Sarasvatt belongs the human' voiced Maina; to Ground the porcupine; tiger, wolf, viper belong to Passion; to Sarasvata the human-voiced parrot.

verses.sa: सुपर्णः पार्जन्य आतिर्वाहसो दर्विदा ते वायवे बृहस्पतये वाचस्पतये पैङ्गराजोऽलज आन्तरिक्षः प्लवो मद्गुर्मत्स्यस्ते नदीपतये द्यावापृथिवीयः कूर्मः॥
verses.tr: suparṇaḥ pārjanya ātirvāhaso darvidā te vāyave bṛhaspataye vācaspataye paiṅgarājo'laja āntarikṣaḥ plavo madgurmatsyaste nadīpataye dyāvāpṛthivīyaḥ kūrmaḥ
verses.en: The eagle is Parjanya's; the Ati,, the V&hasa, the wood-pecker, these are for Vflyu; for Brihaspati Lord of' Speech" is the Paingardja; the Alaja belongs to Firmament; pelican, cormorant, fish, these belong to the Lord of Rivers; the tortoise belongs to Heaven and Earth.

verses.sa: पुरुषमृगश्चन्द्रमसो गोधा कालका दार्वाघाटस्ते वनस्पतीनां कृकवाकुः सावित्रो हंसो वातस्य नाक्रो मकरः कुलीपयस्तेऽकूपारस्य ह्रियै शल्यकः॥
verses.tr: puruṣamṛgaścandramaso godhā kālakā dārvāghāṭaste vanaspatīnāṃ kṛkavākuḥ sāvitro haṃso vātasya nākro makaraḥ kulīpayaste'kūpārasya hriyai śalyakaḥ
verses.en: The buck belongs to the Moon; iguana, K&Jak^, woodpecker,, these belong to the Vanaspatis; the cock belongs to Savitar-; the swan< is VAta's: crocodile, dolphin, Kulipaya,. these belong; to the Sea;, the porcupine to Modesty.

verses.sa: एण्यह्नो मण्डूको मूषिका तित्तिरिस्ते सर्पाणां लोपाश आश्विनः कृष्णो रात्र्या ऋक्षो जतूः सुषिलीका त इतरजनानां जहका वैष्णवी॥
verses.tr: eṇyahno maṇḍūko mūṣikā tittiriste sarpāṇāṃ lopāśa āśvinaḥ kṛṣṇo rātryā ṛkṣo jatūḥ suṣilīkā ta itarajanānāṃ jahakā vaiṣṇavī
verses.en: The Black-doe belongs to Day; frog-, female rat, partridge;, these belong to the Serpents; the jackal belongs to the A'S^ins; the Black-buck to Night; bear, bat, Sushilikl,. these belong, to the Other Folk.;, the polecat belongs to Vishnu.

verses.sa: अन्यवापोऽर्धमासानामृश्यो मयूरः सुपर्णस्ते गन्धर्वाणामपामुद्रो मासां कश्यपो रोहित्कुण्डृणाची गोलत्तिका तेऽप्सरसां मृत्यवेऽसितः॥
verses.tr: anyavāpo'rdhamāsānāmṛśyo mayūraḥ suparṇaste gandharvāṇāmapāmudro māsāṃ kaśyapo rohitkuṇḍṛṇācī golattikā te'psarasāṃ mṛtyave'sitaḥ
verses.en: The cuckoo belongs to the Half Months; antelope, peacock, eagle; these are the Gandharvas-; the otter belongs to the Months; tortoise, doe-antelope,, iguana, Granthika belong to the Apsarases; the black snake belong to Death.

verses.sa: वर्षाहूरृतूनामाखुः कशो मान्थालस्ते पितॄणां बलायाजगरो वसूनां कपिञ्जलः कपोत उलूकः शशस्ते निरृत्यै वरुणायारण्यो मेषः॥
verses.tr: varṣāhūrṛtūnāmākhuḥ kaśo mānthālaste pitṝṇāṃ balāyājagaro vasūnāṃ kapiñjalaḥ kapota ulūkaḥ śaśaste nirṛtyai varuṇāyāraṇyo meṣaḥ
verses.en: The frog belongs to the Seasons;: the vole, the rat, the mouse, these are the Fathers'; the Python, the Bal^ya belong to the Vasus; Kapinjala, pigeon, owl, hare belong, to Nirriti; the wild ram to Varuna.

verses.sa: श्वित्र आदित्यानामुष्ट्रो घृणीवान्वार्ध्रीनसस्ते मत्या अरण्याय सृमरो रुरू रौद्रः क्वयिः कुटरुर्दात्यौहस्ते वाजिनां कामाय पिकः॥
verses.tr: śvitra ādityānāmuṣṭro ghṛṇīvānvārdhrīnasaste matyā araṇyāya sṛmaro rurū raudraḥ kvayiḥ kuṭarurdātyauhaste vājināṃ kāmāya pikaḥ
verses.en: The white animal belongs to the Adityas;; the camel, the GbrinlrvaD,, the rhinoceros to Mati; the Srimara belong to the Forest-God; the Ruru buck is Rudra's; Kva^i, cock, gallinule,, these are the Vajins'';; the cuckoo belongs to Kama..

verses.sa: खङ्गो वैश्वदेवः श्वा कृष्णः कर्णो गर्दभस्तरक्षुस्ते रक्षसामिन्द्राय सूकरः सिंहो मारुतः कृकलासः पिप्पका शकुनिस्ते शरव्यायै विश्वेषां देवानां पृषतः॥
verses.tr: khaṅgo vaiśvadevaḥ śvā kṛṣṇaḥ karṇo gardabhastarakṣuste rakṣasāmindrāya sūkaraḥ siṃho mārutaḥ kṛkalāsaḥ pippakā śakuniste śaravyāyai viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ pṛṣataḥ
verses.en: The Khaoera is the All-Gods'; y the black dog-, the long^eared',. the ass, the, thehyena, these are the thelisbkshasas'; the boar is for Indra;: the lion is for the Maruts;; the chameleon, the- Pippala, the vulture, these belong to §Sbravy: the spotted antelope' belong to the All-Gods..
